query:
-- 查詢該卡牌最近 3 個月的 PSA 10 價格歷史
SELECT 
  ph.cardId,
  ph.price,
  ph.grade,
  ph.transactionDate,
  ph.source,
  c.name,
  c.nameJa
FROM priceHistory ph
JOIN cards c ON ph.cardId = c.id
WHERE c.name LIKE '%Japanese National Team%'
  AND ph.grade = 'PSA10'
  AND ph.transactionDate >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
ORDER BY ph.transactionDate ASC
LIMIT 20;
